---
# No `title` here: the document is titled after the site it reports on, which
# is not known until the GeoPackage has been read, so the heading is written
# from R in the first block below.
lang: en-GB
format:
  typst:
    papersize: a4
    fontsize: 10pt
    margin:
      x: 2cm
      y: 2cm
    section-numbering: ""
    fig-format: png
    fig-dpi: 200
    # The report's colours, which are the website's. Held in their own file
    # rather than inline here so that a colour can be changed in one place and
    # so that `run_test_site_report.R` can read them back and check they still
    # agree with `custom.scss`.
    include-in-header: gbif-report.typ
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  # Every path is absolute when `site_reports.R` renders this. The defaults are
  # relative to this directory, so that a single report can also be rebuilt by
  # hand from the repository root:
  #
  #   quarto render reports/site_report.qmd \
  #     -P gpkg:../outputs/protected_areas/<slug>/<slug>.gpkg
  #
  # The GeoPackage is the source of every figure below. The report does not
  # recompute what the file already states, which is what makes the two agree.
  gpkg: ""
  country: "../data/kosovo_boundary.gpkg"
  municipalities: "../data/kosovo_municipalities.gpkg"
  national: "../outputs/national_site_statistics.csv"
  datasets: "../data/dataset_registry.csv"
  functions: "../R/functions.R"
  site_report: "../R/site_report.R"
  command: ""
  max_points: 20000
---

```{r}
#| label: guard
#| output: asis

# Rendered with no site, this document describes itself and stops, rather than
# failing. The reason is the repository root's `_quarto.yml`, whose render list
# matches every `.qmd` in the project: a plain `quarto render` of the website
# reaches this file too, and a template that raised an error here would take
# the whole site build down with it. Add `"!reports/"` to that render list to
# keep the website away from this directory altogether.

if (!nzchar(params$gpkg)) {
  cat(
    "# Site report template\n\n",
    "This document reports on **one protected area**, and is rendered once ",
    "per site by `site_reports.R`. It is not a report in itself: it needs the ",
    "site GeoPackage that carries the figures.\n\n",
    "```bash\n",
    "Rscript site_reports.R --site NP_001\n",
    "```\n\n",
    "To render a single site by hand from an existing GeoPackage — the path ",
    "is relative to `reports/`, where the document is executed, or absolute:",
    "\n\n",
    "```bash\n",
    "quarto render reports/site_report.qmd \\\n",
    "  -P gpkg:../outputs/protected_areas/<slug>/<slug>.gpkg\n",
    "```\n\n",
    "See the README section *Site reports for individual protected areas*.\n",
    sep = "")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: setup

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(sf)
  library(ggplot2)
})

source(params$functions)
source(params$site_report)

dataset <- read_site_gpkg(params$gpkg)

boundary <- dataset$site_boundary
md       <- dataset$report_metadata
occ      <- dataset$occurrences
inside   <- occ[which(occ$inside_site), , drop = FALSE]
species  <- dataset$species_summary
strict   <- dataset$strict_protection
units    <- dataset$municipalities_overlapping
grid     <- dataset$record_density_grid

# The map settings are read back out of the file rather than chosen here, so
# that the figures are drawn to the same parameters the layers were built with.
cfg <- list(
  crs_storage    = as.integer(sub("EPSG:", "", meta_value(md, "crs_storage"))),
  crs_metric     = as.integer(sub("EPSG:", "", meta_value(md, "crs_metric"))),
  locator_ring_m = as.numeric(meta_value(md, "locator_ring_m")),
  map_max_points = as.numeric(meta_value(md, "map_max_points"))
)
if (is.na(cfg$map_max_points)) cfg$map_max_points <- as.numeric(params$max_points)

country <- sf::st_read(params$country, quiet = TRUE)
munis   <- sf::st_read(params$municipalities, quiet = TRUE)

# --- Formatting helpers -------------------------------------------------------
#
# An unknown value prints as an em dash rather than as "NA": the tables are
# read by people, and "NA" in a printed report is a defect, not a value.

or_dash <- function(x, format = identity) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x[1]) || identical(x[1], "")) "—"
  else format(x[1])
}
n_fmt   <- function(x) or_dash(x, function(v) fmt_int(as.numeric(v)))
num_fmt <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  or_dash(x, function(v) formatC(as.numeric(v), format = "f", digits = digits,
                                 big.mark = ","))
}
pct_fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  or_dash(x, function(v) paste0(formatC(100 * as.numeric(v), format = "f",
                                        digits = digits), " per cent"))
}

# An area is printed in the unit it can be read in: hectares below a square
# kilometre, square kilometres above it, with the unit always stated.
area_ha <- function(v) {
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  if (v >= 100) paste0(fmt_int(round(v)), " ha")
  else paste0(formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 2), " ha")
}
area_km2 <- function(v) {
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  if (v >= 0.01) paste0(formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 2), " km²")
  else paste0(formatC(v * 100, format = "f", digits = 2), " ha")
}

# A share that is small but real must not print as "0.0%". A natural monument
# of twelve hectares genuinely does cover four hundredths of a per cent of its
# municipality, and a rounded zero would read as "none of it".
share_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  out   <- paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = digits), "%")
  floor <- 10^(-digits) / 2
  out[!is.na(x) & x > 0 & 100 * x < floor] <-
    paste0("<", formatC(10^(-digits), format = "f", digits = digits), "%")
  out[is.na(x)] <- "—"
  out
}

report_table <- function(x, caption = NULL, widths = NULL) {

  out <- knitr::kable(x, format = "pipe", caption = caption, align = NULL)
  if (is.null(widths)) return(out)

  # A table with a swatch in it has to state its own column widths. Pandoc
  # sizes a column from the source text, and `#swatch(rgb("#fab219"))` is
  # thirty characters of markup that occupy no room on the page; left to
  # itself the swatched column takes twice the width it needs, out of the
  # species names beside it.
  structure(
    c(sprintf("::: {tbl-colwidths=\"[%s]\"}", paste(widths, collapse = ",")),
      "", out, "", ":::"),
    format = "pipe", class = "knitr_kable")
}

# --- Colour carried into the tables -------------------------------------------
#
# The print counterparts of two pieces the website builds in HTML: the category
# swatch `swatch()` puts in every species table in `report.qmd`, and the brand
# green `.keyfigure .value` wears in `custom.scss`. Both emit raw Typst, which
# the cell carries through `kable()` untouched, and both defer to
# `reports/gbif-report.typ` for the colour itself — nothing here chooses one.

swatch <- function(colour, label) {
  sprintf("`#swatch(rgb(\"%s\"))`{=typst} %s", colour, label)
}

key_value <- function(x) {
  sprintf("`#keyfigure[%s]`{=typst}", x)
}

# A table long enough to run over a page is truncated, and the truncation is
# stated. The full list is always in the GeoPackage.
top_rows <- function(x, n) {
  if (nrow(x) <= n) return(list(table = x, omitted = 0L))
  list(table = utils::head(x, n), omitted = nrow(x) - n)
}

site_name   <- boundary$site_name[1]
designation <- boundary$designation[1]
```

```{r}
#| label: header
#| output: asis

cat("# ", site_name, "\n\n", sep = "")

header <- dplyr::tibble(
  Field = c(
    "Designation (English)",
    "Designation (Albanian)",
    "National identifier",
    "Register identifier",
    "IUCN management category",
    "Designated",
    "Reported area",
    "Computed area",
    "Boundary",
    "Responsible authority",
    "Management plan recorded",
    "Ecosystem type"
  ),
  Value = c(
    or_dash(designation),
    or_dash(boundary$designation_sq[1]),
    or_dash(boundary$national_id[1]),
    or_dash(boundary$natda_id[1]),
    or_dash(boundary$iucn_management_category[1]),
    or_dash(boundary$designation_year[1], as.character),
    # Rounded to the unit the figure can actually carry. Most of this register
    # is natural monuments of a few hundred square metres, and "0 ha" for a
    # quarter-hectare spring reads as no area at all.
    or_dash(boundary$reported_area_ha[1], area_ha),
    or_dash(boundary$computed_area_km2[1], area_km2),
    or_dash(boundary$boundary_basis[1]),
    or_dash(boundary$authority[1]),
    or_dash(boundary$management_plan[1]),
    or_dash(boundary$ecosystem_type[1])
  )
)

print(report_table(header))
cat("\n")

if (!identical(boundary$geometry_source[1], "boundary")) {
  cat("\n*This site has no mapped boundary in the register. It is recorded as",
      "a single point, and everything below is measured inside a circle of the",
      "area the register reports for it. That circle is a stand-in for a",
      "boundary, not a survey of one, and any figure given per square",
      "kilometre is therefore a statement about the size of the circle as much",
      "as about the site.*\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: buffer-note
#| output: asis

cat(sprintf(
  paste0("The dashed line is a %s m buffer around the site. It holds %s ",
         "further records that are **not** inside the site, and they are in ",
         "the GeoPackage flagged `in_buffer_only`: what has been recorded ",
         "just outside a boundary is often the best available guide to what ",
         "is inside one that nobody has surveyed.\n\n"),
  n_fmt(meta_value(md, "buffer_m")),
  n_fmt(boundary$records_in_buffer_only[1])))

if (nrow(strict)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0("%s strict-protection zone%s lie%s inside this site, covering ",
           "%s km² and holding %s of its records. Those records are ",
           "counted in the site's totals, not additional to them.\n\n"),
    fmt_int(nrow(strict)),
    if (nrow(strict) == 1) "" else "s",
    if (nrow(strict) == 1) "s" else "",
    num_fmt(sum(strict$computed_area_km2)),
    n_fmt(sum(strict$records))))
}

## Key figures

```{r}
#| label: key-figures
#| output: asis

national <- if (file.exists(params$national)) {
  # The identifiers are read as text explicitly. Left to the type guesser they
  # arrive as numbers, and an identifier with a leading zero — which some
  # national registers use — would lose it silently on the way in.
  readr::read_csv(
    params$national,
    col_types = readr::cols(natda_id = readr::col_character(),
                            national_id = readr::col_character(),
                            .default = readr::col_guess()),
    progress = FALSE)
} else {
  NULL
}

figures <- dplyr::tibble(
  Measure = c("Records", "Species", "Families", "Source datasets",
              "Records per km²", "First observation",
              "Most recent observation"),
  Value = key_value(c(
    n_fmt(boundary$records[1]),
    n_fmt(boundary$species[1]),
    n_fmt(boundary$families[1]),
    n_fmt(boundary$datasets[1]),
    num_fmt(boundary$records_per_km2[1], 1),
    or_dash(boundary$first_year[1], as.character),
    or_dash(boundary$last_year[1], as.character)
  ))
)

if (!is.null(national)) {
  ranks <- site_ranks(national, boundary$natda_id[1])
  rank_for <- function(measure) {
    hit <- ranks[ranks$measure == measure, ]
    if (!nrow(hit) || is.na(hit$rank[1])) return("—")
    paste0(fmt_int(hit$rank[1]), " of ", fmt_int(hit$of[1]))
  }
  figures$`National rank` <- c(
    rank_for("Records"), rank_for("Species"), rank_for("Families"),
    rank_for("Source datasets"), rank_for("Records per km²"),
    "—", "—")
}

print(report_table(figures))
cat("\n")

if (is.null(national)) {
  cat("\n*The national ranking table",
      paste0("(`", params$national, "`)"),
      "was not found, so no ranks are shown. It is written by",
      "`site_reports.R` at the start of every run.*\n\n")
} else {
  cat("\nRanks are against the", fmt_int(nrow(national)),
      "designated sites in the register, counted the same way for every",
      "site. Records per square kilometre measures recording effort, not",
      "richness: it rises with the number of people who have visited, and a",
      "small site with one well-watched spot in it can lead the country on",
      "that column while holding few species.\n\n")
}
```

## Taxonomic composition

```{r}
#| label: taxonomy
#| output: asis

taxonomy <- site_taxonomic_summary(inside)

if (!nrow(taxonomy)) {
  cat("No records, so there is nothing to break down by kingdom.\n\n")
} else {
  print(report_table(
    taxonomy |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        Kingdom = .data$kingdom,
        Records = fmt_int(.data$records),
        Species = fmt_int(.data$species),
        `Share of records` = paste0(
          formatC(100 * .data$records / sum(.data$records), format = "f",
                  digits = 1), " per cent")
      )))
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Species of conservation interest

```{r}
#| label: threatened
#| output: asis

cat("### Assessed as threatened on the IUCN Red List\n\n")

threatened <- species |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$iucnRedListCategory %in% iucn_threatened) |>
  dplyr::arrange(match(.data$iucnRedListCategory, iucn_levels),
                 dplyr::desc(.data$records), .data$species)

if (!nrow(threatened)) {
  cat("No species recorded in this site carries a global Red List assessment",
      "of Critically Endangered, Endangered or Vulnerable. That is a",
      "statement about the records, not about the site: a species that has",
      "never been recorded here cannot appear in this table.\n\n")
} else {
  shown <- top_rows(threatened, 20)
  print(report_table(
    shown$table |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        Species    = .data$species,
        `Common name` = dplyr::coalesce(.data$vernacularName, "—"),
        Category   = swatch(
          unname(map_palette$iucn[.data$iucnRedListCategory]),
          paste0(.data$iucnRedListCategory, " — ",
                 iucn_names[.data$iucnRedListCategory])),
        Records    = fmt_int(.data$records),
        `Last seen` = dplyr::coalesce(as.character(.data$last_year), "—")
      ),
    widths = c(24, 30, 26, 9, 11)))
  cat("\n")
  if (shown$omitted > 0) {
    cat("\n*", fmt_int(shown$omitted), " further threatened species are in ",
        "the `species_summary` layer of the GeoPackage.*\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: annexes
#| output: asis

cat("### Listed on the EU Nature Directives\n\n")

listed <- species |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$directive), nzchar(.data$directive)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(.data$directive, .data$annex, dplyr::desc(.data$records),
                 .data$species)

if (!nrow(listed)) {
  cat("No species recorded in this site is listed on the Birds or Habitats",
      "Directive annexes. The annexes are EU-wide lists dominated by species",
      "of other biogeographical regions, so this is common and is not by",
      "itself a finding about the site.\n\n")
} else {
  shown <- top_rows(listed, 20)
  print(report_table(
    shown$table |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        Species       = .data$species,
        `Common name` = dplyr::coalesce(.data$vernacularName, "—"),
        Directive     = .data$directive,
        Annex         = dplyr::coalesce(.data$annex, "—"),
        Records       = fmt_int(.data$records)
      )))
  cat("\n")
  if (shown$omitted > 0) {
    cat("\n*", fmt_int(shown$omitted), " further listed species are in the ",
        "`species_summary` layer of the GeoPackage.*\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```

## Recording effort, and where it is absent

```{r}
#| label: effort
#| output: asis

cells       <- boundary$grid_cells[1]
with_record <- boundary$grid_cells_with_records[1]
unrecorded  <- boundary$unrecorded_share[1]

cat("**A site with no records is not a site with no species.** It is a site",
    "nobody has surveyed, or one whose surveys were never published to GBIF.",
    "Everything above describes what has been recorded and published; none of",
    "it describes what is there.\n\n")

cat(sprintf(
  paste0("The site is covered by %s grid cells of one square kilometre. ",
         "%s of them hold at least one record, and **%s of the site's area ",
         "falls in cells with no record at all**.\n\n"),
  n_fmt(cells), n_fmt(with_record), pct_fmt(unrecorded)))

years <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(inside$year))
years <- years[!is.na(years) & years > 1500]

if (length(years)) {
  gaps <- setdiff(seq(min(years), max(years)), sort(unique(years)))
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0("Records run from %d to %d. Of those %s years, %s produced no ",
           "record from this site at all.\n\n"),
    min(years), max(years),
    fmt_int(max(years) - min(years) + 1), fmt_int(length(gaps))))
} else {
  cat("No record from this site carries a usable year, so the recording",
      "history cannot be described.\n\n")
}

if (nrow(grid)) {
  by_class <- grid |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::group_by(`Records per cell` = .data$density_class) |>
    dplyr::summarise(Cells = dplyr::n(), Records = sum(.data$records),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(.data$`Records per cell`, plain_text(density_labels)))

  print(report_table(
    by_class |>
      dplyr::mutate(Cells = fmt_int(.data$Cells),
                    Records = fmt_int(.data$Records)),
    caption = "Recorded cells by density class, on the classes the national report uses."))
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: datasets
#| output: asis

if (nrow(inside)) {

  registry <- if (file.exists(params$datasets)) {
    readr::read_csv(params$datasets, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
  } else {
    dplyr::tibble(datasetKey = character())
  }

  top <- inside |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::count(datasetKey = .data$datasetKey, name = "records") |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$records), .data$datasetKey) |>
    utils::head(5) |>
    dplyr::left_join(registry, by = "datasetKey")

  cat("The records come from", fmt_int(boundary$datasets[1]),
      "datasets. The largest contributors are:\n\n")

  print(report_table(
    top |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        Dataset   = dplyr::coalesce(.data$datasetTitle, .data$datasetKey),
        Publisher = dplyr::coalesce(.data$publisher, "—"),
        Records   = fmt_int(.data$records),
        # Per cent as a symbol, not as words: this table has five columns of
        # long publisher names and a spelled-out unit wraps onto three lines.
        Share     = paste0(
          formatC(100 * .data$records / boundary$records[1], format = "f",
                  digits = 1), "%")
      )))
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Provenance and citation

```{r}
#| label: provenance
#| output: asis

provenance <- dplyr::tibble(
  Item = c("Occurrence data", "GBIF download DOI", "Protected-area register",
           "Register licence", "Licences in this extract", "Generated",
           "Tool", "Source revision", "Storage CRS", "Measurement CRS"),
  Value = c(
    "Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF)",
    or_dash(meta_value(md, "gbif_download_doi")),
    paste(or_dash(meta_value(md, "register_source")),
          or_dash(meta_value(md, "register_version"))),
    or_dash(meta_value(md, "register_licence")),
    or_dash(meta_value(md, "licences_in_extract")),
    or_dash(meta_value(md, "run_timestamp_utc")),
    paste0(or_dash(meta_value(md, "tool")), " ",
           or_dash(meta_value(md, "tool_version"))),
    or_dash(meta_value(md, "code_revision")),
    or_dash(meta_value(md, "crs_storage")),
    or_dash(meta_value(md, "crs_metric"))
  )
)

print(report_table(provenance))
cat("\n\n")

cat("**Cite the occurrence data as:**\n\n")
cat("> ", or_dash(meta_value(md, "gbif_citation")), "\n\n", sep = "")

cat("**Cite the protected-area boundary as:** ",
    or_dash(meta_value(md, "register_source")), ", ",
    or_dash(meta_value(md, "register_version")), ", ",
    or_dash(meta_value(md, "register_licence")),
    ", DOI ", or_dash(meta_value(md, "register_doi")), ".\n\n", sep = "")

command <- if (nzchar(params$command)) params$command else
  meta_value(md, "command")

cat("**This document is reproduced by:**\n\n")
cat("```\n", or_dash(command), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")

cat("Every figure above is read from `", basename(params$gpkg), "`, which is ",
    "published alongside this document and holds the records, the species ",
    "list, the grids and this provenance as GeoPackage layers.\n\n", sep = "")

cat("Records are counted by intersection with the site boundary. A record ",
    "falling inside two overlapping sites is therefore reported in both, ",
    "which is what a reader of either site's report needs; the national ",
    "report counts each record once, against the smallest site containing ",
    "it, so its total for this site can be slightly lower.\n", sep = "")
```
